dialogues.jp: 「うーむ……」
まだ来てないのか……。

１時限目が終わり、休み時間に萌先輩の教室を
覗いてみたが、まだ来ていなかった。
dialogues.en:
The first period ended, and I came to look inside
Moe-sempai's classroom but she was still not there.
dialogues.text:
The first period ended, and I came to look inside
Moe-sempai's classroom but she was still not there.

dialogues.jp: （眞子にでも｛き／訊｝いてみるか……）
俺は階段を下りて、１組の教室に向かった。
dialogues.en: I went down the stairs and headed toward Class 1.
dialogues.text: I went down the stairs and headed toward Class 1.

dialogues.jp:
１階に下りたところで、俺のクラスから出てき
た眞子を見つける。
dialogues.en:
When I got to the first floor, I saw Mako coming out of my
classroom.
dialogues.text:
When I got to the first floor, I saw Mako coming out of my
classroom.

dialogues.jp: 「おい、眞子」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あっ、朝倉」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あんた、どこ行ってたのよ」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ちょっとな……」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「それより、萌先輩って、今日学園に来てない
　のか？」
dialogues.en: "By the way, is Moe-sempai not coming to the school today?"
dialogues.text: "By the way, is Moe-sempai not coming to the school today?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「え……休みだけど」
ちょっと沈み気味に眞子が答える。
dialogues.en: Mako answered with a sad face.
dialogues.text: Mako answered with a sad face.

dialogues.jp: 「そうか……なんだ、休みだったのか」

どうやら無駄足で、憂鬱な気分は杞憂ですんで
しまったようだ。
dialogues.en: I guess I was just wasting my time.
dialogues.text: I guess I was just wasting my time.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あたしも、ちょっと話があるんだけど」
dialogues.en: "I needed to talk to you about something."
dialogues.text: "I needed to talk to you about something."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ？」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「……ちょっと一緒に来てくれる？」

そう言って、俺の返事を聞かずに、眞子が背を
向けて歩き出す。
dialogues.en: She spoke and started walking before I said anything.
dialogues.text: She spoke and started walking before I said anything.

dialogues.jp: 「おい、ちょっと待てって」
呼び止める俺を無視して、階段をのぼっていく。
dialogues.en: She ignored me and started going up the stairs.
dialogues.text: She ignored me and started going up the stairs.

dialogues.jp: 「ったく、仕方ないな……」
俺も眞子を追いかけて階段を上る。
dialogues.en: I followed her and climbed up the stairs.
dialogues.text: I followed her and climbed up the stairs.

dialogues.jp: 「なんだよ、こんな所まで連れてきて」
強い風に吹かれながら、眞子の横顔を見つめる。
dialogues.en:
"What do you want from me, and why did you bring me all the
way up here?"
dialogues.text:
"What do you want from me, and why did you bring me all the
way up here?"

dialogues.jp:
眞子は黙ったまま遠くの海を見下ろしていたが、
やがて何かを決意したように振り返った。
dialogues.en:
She remained silent and stared down at the ocean, but then
she suddenly turned around toward me.
dialogues.text:
She remained silent and stared down at the ocean, but then
she suddenly turned around toward me.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あんたさ……お姉ちゃんと最近会ってる？」
dialogues.en: "Have you been seeing my sister lately......?"
dialogues.text: "Have you been seeing my sister lately......?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「えっ」
いきなり萌先輩のことを言われ、ドキリとする。
dialogues.en:
My heart pounded when she asked me about Moe-sempai all of a
sudden.
dialogues.text:
My heart pounded when she asked me about Moe-sempai all of a
sudden.

dialogues.jp: 「な、なんだよ……いきなり」
dialogues.en: "Why are you suddenly asking me this......?"
dialogues.text: "Why are you suddenly asking me this......?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「お姉ちゃんとうまくいってるの？」
dialogues.en: "Is everything going fine between the two of you?"
dialogues.text: "Is everything going fine between the two of you?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「……そんなの、おまえに関係ないだろう」

先輩とのことを見透かされたみたいで、ぶっき
らぼうに答えてしまう。
dialogues.en:
I answered bluntly as I felt like she already knew happened
between me and Moe-sempai.
dialogues.text:
I answered bluntly as I felt like she already knew happened
between me and Moe-sempai.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「あんた……お姉ちゃんをどうして、放ってお
　くのよ」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「それは……」
フラれたんだから、仕方ないじゃないか……。
dialogues.en: I was dumped, I have no choice......
dialogues.text: I was dumped, I have no choice......

dialogues.jp: 「おまえには関係ないだろう――」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「関係あるのよ！」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「……なんだよ急に？」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「お姉ちゃんはあたしの大事な家族なんだよ？　
　あんた、音夢に何かあっても放っておくの？」
dialogues.en:
"My sister's my family. Would you leave Nemu alone if
something happened to her?"
dialogues.text:
"My sister's my family. Would you leave Nemu alone if
something happened to her?"

dialogues.jp: 眞子が声を荒げる。
確かに、屋上でなければマズい声量だ。
dialogues.en: I'm glad we're on the rooftop.
dialogues.text: I'm glad we're on the rooftop.

dialogues.jp: 「……色恋沙汰は口出し出来ないだろうが」
dialogues.en: "......I can't get into her love life......"
dialogues.text: "......I can't get into her love life......"

dialogues.jp: 仕方なくぶっきらぼうに呟く。

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「そりゃ！　……そうだけどさぁ」
眞子が肩を落とす。

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「せっかくお姉ちゃんが明るくなったのにさ……
　あたし、なにも出来なくて悔しくて」
dialogues.en:
"Moe was finally becoming so happy...... I'm frustrated that
I can't do anything to cheer her up......"
dialogues.text:
"Moe was finally becoming so happy...... I'm frustrated that
I can't do anything to cheer her up......"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「でも、お姉ちゃんに避けられるなんて……いっ
　たい何したのよ？」
dialogues.en: "What did you do to make her avoid you?"
dialogues.text: "What did you do to make her avoid you?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「何って……言われても……」
頭をかいて青空を見上げてしまう。
dialogues.en: I scratched my head and looked up at the sky.
dialogues.text: I scratched my head and looked up at the sky.

dialogues.jp: ふぅ……若いな俺も。

「それに思い当たらないから、俺も実際困って
　るんだ」
dialogues.en:
"I can't think of anything, so that's why I'm frustrated
too!"
dialogues.text:
"I can't think of anything, so that's why I'm frustrated
too!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「よぉく考えてみなさい。絶対何かしてるって」
dialogues.en: "Think about it again. You must have done something to her."
dialogues.text: "Think about it again. You must have done something to her."

dialogues.jp: 眞子が確信をもって決めつける。

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「もぅ、せっかく、人が心配してやってんだか
　ら！　原因が分かったらカツ丼でもなんでも
　｛おご／奢｝ってあげるわよ！」
dialogues.en:
"I'm just worried! If you find out what's wrong, I'll get
you anything you want to eat!"
dialogues.text:
"I'm just worried! If you find out what's wrong, I'll get
you anything you want to eat!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「そうだなぁ……」

桜が枯れたって言っても、眞子には分からない
だろうな。
dialogues.en:
She probably won't understand if I tell her that the cherry
blossom died.
dialogues.text:
She probably won't understand if I tell her that the cherry
blossom died.

dialogues.jp:
「そうだ、萌先輩にはたしか幼なじみの男がい
　るだろう？」
dialogues.en: "Well, Moe-sempai has a childhood friend, doesn't she?"
dialogues.text: "Well, Moe-sempai has a childhood friend, doesn't she?"

dialogues.jp: 鳩が豆鉄砲くらったよりも｛ひど／酷｝い顔をみせる。
dialogues.en:
She reacted with a shocked expression, as if she was a
pigeon hit by a BB gun.
dialogues.text:
She reacted with a shocked expression, as if she was a
pigeon hit by a BB gun.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「……ど、どうして、あんたが啓くんのことを
　知ってるの」
夢で見たとは、間違っても言えない。
dialogues.en: I can't tell her that I saw him in a dream.
dialogues.text: I can't tell her that I saw him in a dream.

dialogues.jp: 「そいつと萌先輩が仲良く――」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「有り得ない……」

呟きに顔を向けると、眞子が緊張した面持ちで、
虚ろに視線をさまよわせていた。
dialogues.en:
When I looked at Mako, her eyes were swimming as if she was
extremely nervous.
dialogues.text:
When I looked at Mako, her eyes were swimming as if she was
extremely nervous.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「だって、啓くんは……」
そのまま、黙りこくってしまう。
「どうしたんだ？」

なにか迷っているような表情で眞子が俯むいて
しまう。
dialogues.en: Mako looked away with a confused look.
dialogues.text: Mako looked away with a confused look.

dialogues.jp: 「何かあるのか？」
なんだか、空気が重い。

萌先輩が俺を捨ててあの男の子の元にいったと
しても、眞子の顔色は重過ぎる。
dialogues.en: The way Mako looked was out of the ordinary.
dialogues.text: The way Mako looked was out of the ordinary.

dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、俺が言うのもなんだが、あの啓一って
　やつは悪い奴には見えないし……」
dialogues.en:
"Well, I don't know if I should be saying this, but that guy
Keiichi doesn't look like a bad guy......"
dialogues.text:
"Well, I don't know if I should be saying this, but that guy
Keiichi doesn't look like a bad guy......"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「啓くんは……いい奴だったけど」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「しかし、そんな簡単に萌先輩をあきらめたわ
　けじゃないぞ！　今度会ってしっかり話をす
　れば――」
dialogues.en:
"But it doesn't mean that I gave up on Moe-sempai! I'm going
to see her tomorrow and talk......"
dialogues.text:
"But it doesn't mean that I gave up on Moe-sempai! I'm going
to see her tomorrow and talk......"

dialogues.jp: 言葉が止まった。
何かがおかしい。

「なぁ、眞子……今お前、なんか変な言い方し
　なかったか？」
dialogues.en: "Hey Mako...... You just said that in a weird way......"
dialogues.text: "Hey Mako...... You just said that in a weird way......"

dialogues.jp: いい奴――｛・・・／だった｝？

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「啓くんは……もう……でるから……」
消え入りそうな声で眞子が何かを呟く。
dialogues.en: Mako muttered something with a fading voice.
dialogues.text: Mako muttered something with a fading voice.

dialogues.jp: 「なに？」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「啓くんは、もう死んでるのっ！」
死んでる？
「なに、言ってるんだお前？」

冗談にしかならないのに、眞子は一片の笑みを
浮かべることなく瞳を伏せる。
dialogues.en:
This was a bad joke, but she remained looking away without
smiling.
dialogues.text:
This was a bad joke, but she remained looking away without
smiling.

dialogues.jp:
「バカ言うなよ！　萌先輩は、もう一度そいつ
　に会うって言ってたんだぞ！？」
dialogues.en:
"Don't be silly! Moe-sempai said she's going to see him
again!"
dialogues.text:
"Don't be silly! Moe-sempai said she's going to see him
again!"

dialogues.jp: 「死んでる人間に、どうやって会うんだ！？」
dialogues.en: "How can she see someone who's dead already?"
dialogues.text: "How can she see someone who's dead already?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「会えるの……夢の中なら……」
dialogues.en: "She can see him...... in her dreams......"
dialogues.text: "She can see him...... in her dreams......"

dialogues.jp: 今度こそ、俺も言葉を失った。
dialogues.en: This time I was lost for words.
dialogues.text: This time I was lost for words.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「子供の頃、お姉ちゃん言ってたの……夢の中
　で啓くんに会えるって」
dialogues.en:
"When we were younger, oneechan used to tell me that she can
see Kei-kun in her dreams......"
dialogues.text:
"When we were younger, oneechan used to tell me that she can
see Kei-kun in her dreams......"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「自分の身体のなかに、啓くんの魂が宿ってい
　るって、信じてるの」
dialogues.en:
"She believes that Kei-kun's spirit is resting inside of her
body."
dialogues.text:
"She believes that Kei-kun's spirit is resting inside of her
body."

dialogues.jp: そんなバカな……。
「い、いくら萌先輩だって、そんなこと……」
『幽霊だって魂だって在りますよ』

『だって、存在しないものに、言葉はつきませ
　んから』
dialogues.en: "If there are no such things, why are there words for it?"
dialogues.text: "If there are no such things, why are there words for it?"

dialogues.jp: 「あれは……」
あれはそういう意味だったのか？
dialogues.en: She really meant it when it happened?
dialogues.text: She really meant it when it happened?

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「だから、薬まで飲んで眠ってたんだから……」
dialogues.en: "That's why she takes drugs in order to fall asleep......"
dialogues.text: "That's why she takes drugs in order to fall asleep......"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「それって……」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「お姉ちゃんがいつも飲んでたやつ……あれ、
　睡眠薬なんだ」
dialogues.en: "Those pills she was taking, they were sleeping pills."
dialogues.text: "Those pills she was taking, they were sleeping pills."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「……バカだよ」

お互いに正面に立っているのに、視線がぶつか
らない。
dialogues.en:
We were standing face to face but couldn't look in each
other's eyes.
dialogues.text:
We were standing face to face but couldn't look in each
other's eyes.

dialogues.jp:
何を言っても、今では風にかき消されてしまい
そうな声しか出そうにない。
dialogues.en:
No matter what I say, the wind would blow my words away. I
couldn't speak out loud.
dialogues.text:
No matter what I say, the wind would blow my words away. I
couldn't speak out loud.

dialogues.jp: いや……。
それでも……。
「……萌先輩は……どこにいるんだ？」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「えっ？」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「どこにいる？」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「だって……朝倉……」

今度こそ鳩が銀球鉄砲をくらったような顔の眞
子に、笑いかける。
dialogues.en: I smiled at her surprised face.
dialogues.text: I smiled at her surprised face.

dialogues.jp: 「おまえ、俺を誰だと思ってるんだ？」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「変態」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ま……まぁ、そういう冗談はおいておいてだ」

なんだか、こんな時まで言い切られてしまうこ
とに胸が痛む。
dialogues.en:
It's hurtful to hear her say things like that, given the
circumstances.
dialogues.text:
It's hurtful to hear her say things like that, given the
circumstances.

dialogues.jp: 「俺は、｛・・／あの｝萌先輩の恋人だぞ！」

そうとも。ちょっとやそっとのことで挫けてい
たらキリが無い。
dialogues.en: Yes, I am. I can't let one small incident ruin this.
dialogues.text: Yes, I am. I can't let one small incident ruin this.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あ……いや、なにバカなこと言ってんのよ」
dialogues.en: "Oh...... I mean, why are you being so silly?"
dialogues.text: "Oh...... I mean, why are you being so silly?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「真面目な話だろうが」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「そうだね。あのお姉ちゃんの恋人になれるく
　らいだもんね……あんたは！」
dialogues.en:
"You're right. You're crazy enough to be my sister's
boyfriend!"
dialogues.text:
"You're right. You're crazy enough to be my sister's
boyfriend!"

dialogues.jp: 眞子が小さくでも微笑む。

「いまいち、自慢になるかどうかはビミョーな
　ところだけどな」
dialogues.en: "I don't know if I'm supposed to be proud about that......"
dialogues.text: "I don't know if I'm supposed to be proud about that......"

dialogues.jp: 俺も苦笑いを浮かべながら肩をすくめた。
dialogues.en: I shrugged my shoulders as I smiled wryly.
dialogues.text: I shrugged my shoulders as I smiled wryly.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「でさ……悪いんだけど、お姉ちゃんの居場所
　はあたしも知らないんだ」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「家で寝てるんじゃないのか？」
dialogues.en: "Well, I'm sorry, but I don't even know where she is."
dialogues.text: "Well, I'm sorry, but I don't even know where she is."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「それが……朝にはベッドが空になってい
　て……」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.en: "Well...... her bed was empty this morning......"
dialogues.text: "Well...... her bed was empty this morning......"

dialogues.jp: 思わず変なところで驚いてしまう。
「有り得ないだろう、それは？」
dialogues.en: I replied with a surprised voice.
dialogues.text: I replied with a surprised voice.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「あたしだってビックリしたわよ！　だから、
　あんたに声かけたんじゃない！」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「そりゃ、心配にもなるか」
dialogues.en: "I was surprised too! That's why I came to talk to you!"
dialogues.text: "I was surprised too! That's why I came to talk to you!"

dialogues.jp:
むしろ、前日から帰っていないほうが、どこか
で寝ているんじゃないか、と思えるくらいだか
らな。
「早起きってのは……何かあったのか」
dialogues.en:
If she hasn't been home since last night, at least we can
assume that she fell asleep somewhere.
dialogues.text:
If she hasn't been home since last night, at least we can
assume that she fell asleep somewhere.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.en:
"I can't believe she actually woke up early...... I wonder
what happened."
dialogues.text:
"I can't believe she actually woke up early...... I wonder
what happened."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「そうか。サンキュ」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと、どこ行くのよ朝倉っ！」
突然に背を向けた俺に眞子が声をかけてくる。
dialogues.en: Mako called me as I turned around all of a sudden.
dialogues.text: Mako called me as I turned around all of a sudden.

dialogues.jp: 「今から萌先輩を探しに行く！　代返頼むぞ！」
dialogues.en:
"I'm going to look for Moe-sempai now! You answer the call
for me in class!"
dialogues.text:
"I'm going to look for Moe-sempai now! You answer the call
for me in class!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「代返って無茶言わないでよ！」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あぁ、もうじれったいな」
足踏みしながら振り返る。
dialogues.en: I stomped my feet and looked back.
dialogues.text: I stomped my feet and looked back.

dialogues.jp: 「なんとかしろっての」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「そもそもクラスが違うでしょうが！」
dialogues.en: "But we're not even in the same class!"
dialogues.text: "But we're not even in the same class!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ふぅ〜、まったく使えない奴だ」

やれやれ、と深夜の通販番組なみに大きく首を
振る。
dialogues.en:
I shook my head like I do toward the midnight shopping
program.
dialogues.text:
I shook my head like I do toward the midnight shopping
program.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「あ、あんたねぇ……絶対に知っててやってる
　でしょ！？」
dialogues.en:
"You...... you're just trying to give me a hard time, aren't
you?"
dialogues.text:
"You...... you're just trying to give me a hard time, aren't
you?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「ｈａｈａｈａ。まさかシンディ。そんなこと
　有り得ないよ」
dialogues.en: "Hahaha. No way, Cindy. Why would I do that?"
dialogues.text: "Hahaha. No way, Cindy. Why would I do that?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ははは」
思わず吹き出してしまった。
「どうだ元気出ただろう？」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「前にも言っただろうが。おまえはそれくらい
　が可愛いんだって」
dialogues.en: "I told you before. You're cute just like that."
dialogues.text: "I told you before. You're cute just like that."

dialogues.jp: 意地わるく笑いながら肩をすくめる。
dialogues.en: I shrugged my shoulders with a mischievous smile.
dialogues.text: I shrugged my shoulders with a mischievous smile.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉、あんたってやつは……」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「そうじゃないと、可愛くなさ過ぎちまうだろ」
dialogues.en: "Cheer up, or you won't look cute!"
dialogues.text: "Cheer up, or you won't look cute!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「あんたってやつは……本当にその余計な一言
　さえなきゃ……！！」
dialogues.en: "Only if you can shut your mouth......!!"
dialogues.text: "Only if you can shut your mouth......!!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「本当に行くぞ」
手を上げて走り出す。
dialogues.en: I waved my hand and started running.
dialogues.text: I waved my hand and started running.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あ、朝倉……あとひとつだけ」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「……なんだよ。用件は１回で済ませよ」
dialogues.en: "......What is it? Don't keep telling me lots of things!"
dialogues.text: "......What is it? Don't keep telling me lots of things!"

dialogues.jp: 仕方なくまた振り向いてしまう。
dialogues.en: Once again I turned around toward her.
dialogues.text: Once again I turned around toward her.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「あのさ……あんたには悪いんだけど、元気が
　出てるところで。でも、知っておいたほうが
　いいと思って」
dialogues.en:
"Umm...... I feel bad, but I need to tell you something
because you're starting to feel better."
dialogues.text:
"Umm...... I feel bad, but I need to tell you something
because you're starting to feel better."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「なんだ？　もぅ、ここまで来たら何言われて
　も変わらないぞ」
dialogues.en: "What is it? Nothing's going to make me feel worse."
dialogues.text: "What is it? Nothing's going to make me feel worse."

dialogues.jp: ぎゅっ、と拳を握り締めて眞子が頷く。
dialogues.en: Mako nodded as she tightly balled up her fist.
dialogues.text: Mako nodded as she tightly balled up her fist.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「啓くんが死んだの……交通事故なんだ」
風に負けないようにか、眞子が大きな声で叫ぶ。
dialogues.en:
Mako screamed out so her voice wouldn't be blown away by the
wind.
dialogues.text:
Mako screamed out so her voice wouldn't be blown away by the
wind.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「あんたと同じで、お姉ちゃんかばって死んだ
　んだよ……分かる？」
dialogues.en:
"He died when he tried to save my sister...... just like
you. You understand?"
dialogues.text:
"He died when he tried to save my sister...... just like
you. You understand?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ははは……」
思わず笑みがこぼれてしまう。
dialogues.en: I couldn't help but to smile.
dialogues.text: I couldn't help but to smile.

dialogues.jp:
「そりゃ……これ以上ないってくらい、強力な
　｛ライバル／恋敵｝だな」
dialogues.en: "Well...... That means he's a huge rival for me."
dialogues.text: "Well...... That means he's a huge rival for me."

dialogues.jp: かすかに全身が汗ばむ。

死んだ人間は、想像しだいでいくらでもかっこ
よくなるからな……。
dialogues.en:
A dead person can be glamorized, it just takes
imagination......
dialogues.text:
A dead person can be glamorized, it just takes
imagination......

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「助けてあげて。お姉ちゃんを……」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「啓くんも、こんなこと望んでないはずだから」
dialogues.en: "I know Keis-kun wouldn't want this either."
dialogues.text: "I know Keis-kun wouldn't want this either."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「ま、｛ライバル／恋敵｝の心配まではしてやれるかどうか知
　らんがな」
dialogues.en: "I don't know if I'd care about what my rival thinks."
dialogues.text: "I don't know if I'd care about what my rival thinks."

dialogues.jp: 出来るだけ軽さを意識して笑う。
dialogues.en: I tried to smile as lightly as I could.
dialogues.text: I tried to smile as lightly as I could.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あのさ」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あんたなら出来ると思うよ！」
駆けながら、なにげなく呟く。
「やっぱ、笑顔は似合わないか」
dialogues.en: "You don't look like you were really smiling."
dialogues.text: "You don't look like you were really smiling."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「！　だから、あんたってやつは――！」

眞子のいつもの叫び声を背中に聞きながら、俺
は重たい鉄の扉を開いた。
dialogues.en:
As I hear Mako's usual scream, I opened the heavy steel door
of the rooftop.
dialogues.text:
As I hear Mako's usual scream, I opened the heavy steel door
of the rooftop.

dialogues.jp: ◆眞子のハッパ◆
眞子にハッパを掛けられてしまった。

そうだよな、俺は萌先輩の恋人なんだ。俺が、
萌先輩を助けなくちゃ。
dialogues.en: That's right. I'm her boyfriend. I have to save Moe-sempai.
dialogues.text: That's right. I'm her boyfriend. I have to save Moe-sempai.
